Provides a resource to create a vpc eni ipv4 address

## Example Usage

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="javascript,typescript">

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const vpc = new tencentcloud.vpc.Instance("vpc", {
    name: "vpc-example",
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
});
const subnet = new tencentcloud.subnet.Instance("subnet", {
    availabilityZone: "ap-guangzhou-6",
    name: "subnet-example",
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
    isMulticast: false,
});
const example = new tencentcloud.security.Group("example", {
    name: "tf-example",
    description: "sg desc.",
    projectId: 0,
    tags: {
        createBy: "Terraform",
    },
});
const exampleInstance = new tencentcloud.eni.Instance("example", {
    name: "tf-example",
    vpcId: vpc.id,
    subnetId: subnet.id,
    description: "eni desc.",
    ipv4Count: 1,
    securityGroups: [example.id],
});
const exampleIpv4Address = new tencentcloud.eni.Ipv4Address("example", {
    networkInterfaceId: exampleInstance.id,
    qosLevel: "DEFAULT",
    secondaryPrivateIpAddressCount: 3,
});
```
</pulumi-choosable>

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="go">

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/eni"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/security"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/subnet"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/vpc"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		vpc2, err := vpc.NewInstance(ctx, "vpc", &vpc.InstanceArgs{
			Name:      pulumi.String("vpc-example"),
			CidrBlock: pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		subnet2, err := subnet.NewInstance(ctx, "subnet", &subnet.InstanceArgs{
			AvailabilityZone: pulumi.String("ap-guangzhou-6"),
			Name:             pulumi.String("subnet-example"),
			VpcId:            vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			CidrBlock:        pulumi.String("10.0.0.0/16"),
			IsMulticast:      pulumi.Bool(false),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		example, err := security.NewGroup(ctx, "example", &security.GroupArgs{
			Name:        pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			Description: pulumi.String("sg desc."),
			ProjectId:   pulumi.Int(0),
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"createBy": pulumi.String("Terraform"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		exampleInstance, err := eni.NewInstance(ctx, "example", &eni.InstanceArgs{
			Name:        pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			VpcId:       vpc2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			SubnetId:    subnet2.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			Description: pulumi.String("eni desc."),
			Ipv4Count:   pulumi.Int(1),
			SecurityGroups: pulumi.StringArray{
				example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = eni.NewIpv4Address(ctx, "example", &eni.Ipv4AddressArgs{
			NetworkInterfaceId:             exampleInstance.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			QosLevel:                       pulumi.String("DEFAULT"),
			SecondaryPrivateIpAddressCount: pulumi.Int(3),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```

```java
package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Security.Group;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Security.GroupArgs;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.Ipv4Address;
import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.Ipv4AddressArgs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Map;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        var vpc = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.Instance("vpc", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Vpc.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("vpc-example")
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .build());

        var subnet = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.Instance("subnet", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Subnet.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .availabilityZone("ap-guangzhou-6")
            .name("subnet-example")
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .cidrBlock("10.0.0.0/16")
            .isMulticast(false)
            .build());

        var example = new Group("example", GroupArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example")
            .description("sg desc.")
            .projectId(0)
            .tags(Map.of("createBy", "Terraform"))
            .build());

        var exampleInstance = new com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.Instance("exampleInstance", com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Eni.InstanceArgs.builder()
            .name("tf-example")
            .vpcId(vpc.id())
            .subnetId(subnet.id())
            .description("eni desc.")
            .ipv4Count(1)
            .securityGroups(example.id())
            .build());

        var exampleIpv4Address = new Ipv4Address("exampleIpv4Address", Ipv4AddressArgs.builder()
            .networkInterfaceId(exampleInstance.id())
            .qosLevel("DEFAULT")
            .secondaryPrivateIpAddressCount(3)
            .build());

    }
}
```

## Import



vpc eni ipv4 address can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Eni/ipv4Address:Ipv4Address example eni-65369ozn
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
